about: Why the static colony of the first colony run (seed 1, before food withered and before children were born next to their parent) starved. Creatures' saved states at the start of day 4 (static) and archived states from the evolving colony (same creatures at the end of day 1, as the two colonies were identical until then).

steering_index.about: anima.experiments.colony.steering: mean weight from the bearing channels on a creature's left to 'left' minus to 'right', plus the same for its right, relative to w_max. food = sense.bearing->motor, kin = sense.kin->motor.

alone.about: Each creature alone in the same arena (seed 3) for 120 s, energy set to 0.5, food not withering. Meals found.

together.about: The four static creatures together for 60 s from their state at the start of day 4 (all four pieces of food near the edges, nothing growing back), under four interventions.

chance_of_being_near: Four creatures placed uniformly at random in the 18 x 18 arena: a given one is within 3 units of another 22% of the time.
